top_signals.title: NATO allies foil Russian subsea cable sabotage plot
top_signals.summary: The clandestine Russian operation was carried out by Moscow’s GUGI undersea warfare directorate to test a destructive sabotage capability, sources said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil Hits $105 as Iran Shows No Signs of Backing Down
top_signals.summary: Brent crude oil prices top $105 a barrel as rising tensions in the Middle East heighten concerns about global supplies. US gasoline prices hit a record over the Labor Day weekend. Bloomberg's Michael McKee has the data. Mike Reid of RBC says this all puts the Fed in a tough spot. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Iraq Seeks Oil Tankers as Gulf Giants Try to Ensure Hormuz Flows
top_signals.summary: Iraq is holding a tender to hire two or more oil supertankers to perform transits through the Strait of Hormuz, the latest evidence that producers in the region are trying to take greater control of their exports through the chokepoint.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq, Boerse Stuttgart, others ask EU to remove or increase cap in tokenization trial
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
